name: Crash brake on weekly momentum ETH

history.reason: Failed the pre-registered adoption rule: Sharpe 1.21 against 1.23 for plain weekly momentum on ETH 2020-25 (run 20261114-090017-197bbf vs 20261114-084639-25d219). Drawdown barely changed (-41.4% vs -41.6%); return +1,917% vs +2,318%. The brake tripped 29 times and bought back higher than it sold in 16: it mostly sold dips that recovered.
